name: a2uiverse-composition
description: The A2UIVerse composition extension (SPEC §14): the A2A metadata contract for cross-agent UI composition, internal to the platform (orchestrator ↔ client). Two halves: the composition stamp (provenance, placement, generations) on every relayed event, and the synthesize data model — the data model for a2ui composition: a free-form derived data model of formula leaves, a shell-catalog tree bound to it, sort declarations, a note — on the event that paints a synthesis surface. Nothing a2uiverse-specific rides the vendor wire. Normative for every language projection; each projection's contract test asserts against this file.

surfaceIdNamespacing.rule: The orchestrator namespaces surfaceId on the four A2UI server→client message types and reverses it on inbound client actions. Component ids, binding paths, and catalog ids are never rewritten.

compositionStamp.carriedOn: every relayed A2A event's metadata, keyed by stampKey

fields.source: Provenance: the app id the event came from.
fields.slot: Placement: the layout slot the event's surface fills; absent on the shell's own events.
fields.role: Which surface the canvas renders as the composition root: 'shell' | 'fragment'.
fields.vendorContextId: Debug only, gated by orchestrator config.
fields.vendorTaskId: Debug only, gated by orchestrator config.
fields.generations: Per-partition generation counters, keyed by namespaced surfaceId, for every surface this event touched. An integer that only goes up: bumped when an array a live ref indexes into is mutated in place (SPEC §6.2). Absent on the shell's own events — the synthesis surface is derived, not a source.

synthesizeDataModel.carriedOn: metadata.a2uiverseSynthesis of the event that paints a synthesis surface — the client-facing payload; the tree itself is painted as ordinary A2UI on the same event
synthesizeDataModel.authors: The Synthesizer writes synthesizeDataModel as text; the orchestrator validates it (this contract via the sdk validator, then the tree against the shell catalog and the derived-value rule), paints the tree, and sends synthesis with computedAgainst added.

synthesizeDataModel.title: SynthesizeDataModel
synthesizeDataModel.description: Model-facing: what the Synthesizer emits, written as text and validated after. A synthesis carries the tree, the derived data model, the sort declarations and a note; a decline carries declined: true and a reason. The orchestrator adds computedAgainst to the client-facing half.

ref.description: A cross-partition qualified ref: a pointer that resolves in another surface's data model.

surface.description: The namespaced surfaceId (<appId>:<surfaceId>) the pointer resolves in.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into that surface's data model, where a segment may carry a predicate: `items[sku="x"]` selects the element of `items` whose field `sku` equals the JSON literal "x". A predicate ref is valid while the key resolves; an index ref is valid while the partition's generation holds. The key is one field name of the element; the value is a JSON literal compared by JSON equality.

formula.description: A leaf of the derived model: one operator over N refs, N ≥ 0. A plain vendor value is a one-argument pass-through. A formula with no refs is a value no source contributes to — absent by construction. Operators are names the shell catalog declares as functions; the contract does not enumerate them. Recognized by shape: an object with exactly `op` and `args` is a formula.

op.description: A function name declared by the shell catalog.

node.description: A node of the free-form derived model: a formula leaf, an object whose values are nodes, or an array of nodes. A scalar anywhere is a violation — every leaf is a formula, never a literal value.

dataModel.description: The derived data model the tree binds to: a JSON shape of the Synthesizer's choosing whose every leaf is a formula. Evaluated client-side into plain values with contributor state at the same paths.

sort.description: A sort declaration over one array of the derived model. The model names the array, the sortable keys and their labels, and the initial choice; the runtime sorts and keeps the user's choice of key or direction.

path.description: JSON Pointer to the sorted array in the derived model.

options.description: The keys the user may sort by, each with its user-facing label.

key.description: JSON Pointer inside each element of the array, to a formula leaf.
The initial key; one of the options.

tree.description: The synthesis tree: the A2UI components list an agent would put in an updateComponents, authored in the shell catalog. One component has the id `root`. Validated against the shell catalog by the consumer; the contract does not restate a component. Painted as ordinary A2UI; never rides metadata.

note.description: What was delivered and why it differs from the Planner's brief, when it differs; empty otherwise. Journaled, never painted.

declined.description: Nothing is joinable; the reserved slot collapses and no payload is sent.

reason.description: Why nothing was joinable — spoken into the slot as the shell's words.

synthesis.title: SynthesisPayload
synthesis.description: Client-facing: the synthesis branch minus the tree (painted as A2UI) and the note (journaled), plus the generations it was computed against. Evaluated client-side into the synthesis surface's data model.
